about.title: Words
about.p1: I started with words and human languages, and ended up migrating to code and programming languages. The path wasn't easy — after studying English Philology at university, I spent 6 years in logistics. I broke with my "previous life" in 2022 looking for a career change, diving into an intensive Java bootcamp at 30. I loved it and wanted more, so even while working full-time I graduated in the higher degree of Multiplatform Application Development — and that's exactly what makes me different.
about.p2: I know what it's like to start from scratch, to know nothing, to feel lost and overwhelmed. The empathy and resilience I've built along the way allow me to put myself in others' shoes and work in teams that foster a supportive, growth-oriented environment.
about.p3: I currently work as a Software Engineer, building backend microservices with Java Spring Boot for enterprise clients and implementing AI tools with GitHub Copilot. I started as a Java/Angular fullstack developer and have been specialising in backend.
about.p4: In parallel I explore different technologies and build apps with Flutter, Python, Docker, Observability, AI tools, Frontend Frameworks and whatever comes my way. In my spare time I sing soprano in the Diatessaron Choir, and I have a theory that devs who embrace the humanities write better code and make better managers.
